key_path: zero-account compute: `ssh railway.new` gives a free VM + preview URL with no account or card, keyed by SSH key; claim within 24h

`curl -fsSL agents.railway.com | sh` (CLI + agent config) then `railway login`: browser flow (device code over SSH) that signs in OR creates the account. `railway up -y` signs up and deploys in one step
optional: connect GitHub at railway.com/verify for the Full Trial (unverified = Limited Trial with restricted outbound network)
API token: railway.com/account/tokens (account / workspace) or project settings (project token)
MCP: `claude mcp add railway --transport http https://mcp.railway.com` then OAuth (DCR)
human_gates: trial verification via GitHub account age (automated, else Limited Trial)

agent_native_auth.cli_device_flow: yes: `railway login` with device code over SSH; login doubles as signup
agent_native_auth.provisioning_api_mints_keys: partial: 'Login with Railway' OAuth/OIDC for apps (selective workspace/project scopes). Token creation in dashboard; GraphQL API covers resources
agent_native_auth.scoped_tokens: yes: account, workspace and project tokens; OAuth scopes workspace:/project:viewer|member|admin with per-resource selective consent
agent_native_auth.free_tier: yes: Free Trial $5 / 30 days with no card, then Free $1/mo
agent_native_auth.claimable_anonymous: yes (compute): `ssh railway.new` VM, 60 min to build plus 24h to claim; emits a JSON manifest with preview URL and claim link for agents. No anonymous app deploy to a project

mcp.local: local MCP installed by the agents setup script (Railway CLI-based)
mcp.one_click: `curl agents.railway.com | sh` configures agents; MCP server card at /.well-known/mcp/server-card.json; guides for Claude, Cursor, Codex, Copilot, Windsurf, Cline, Devin

docs_for_agents.markdown_pages: yes: append .md; railway.com/index.md serves an agent briefing
docs_for_agents.openapi: https://railway.com/openapi.json (OpenAPI 3.1 for the GraphQL entrypoint + OAuth); GraphQL at backboard.railway.com/graphql/v2
docs_for_agents.use_with_ai_page: https://railway.com/agents.md, https://railway.com/auth.md; discovery docs: /.well-known/ai-catalog.json (ARD), /.well-known/api-catalog (RFC 9727), template deploy manifests

autonomy_note: Autonomous only for the no-signup VM (ssh railway.new). An API credential needs one browser approval.
score_justification: Has the richest machine-readable discovery (ai-catalog, api-catalog, MCP server card, auth.md), DCR+CIMD OAuth with selective scopes, login-as-signup and a no-account VM. Anonymous app deploys are missing.
best_practice: auth.md + RFC 9727 api-catalog + RFC 9728/8414 metadata: one 401 from the MCP teaches a client the whole auth chain, and the doc tells agents which credential type to use
biggest_gap: No anonymous or claimable project deploy (only a VM). Unverified trials get restricted networking. Tokens can only be minted in the dashboard
